This 2011 Ford F-350SD Lariat represents a serious work truck built to handle demanding jobs while delivering the comfort and capability you expect from a premium Super Duty.

Heated and cooled leather front seats with driver memory settings, memory power adjustable pedals, and a remote start system ensure you enter a comfortable cabin regardless of season. PowerScope trailer tow mirrors with integrated sideview capability make towing operations straightforward and visible.

Diesel performance meets premium appointments in this Super Duty. The Power Stroke 6.7L turbodiesel engine, paired with dual batteries and the extra heavy-duty 200-amp alternator, delivers the muscle you need while the Lariat trim's leather steering wheel, premium sound system with satellite radio, and automatic climate control make long workdays more pleasant.

This F-350SD combines capability with considered comfort, making it ready for your toughest jobs while respecting your need for a professional, well-appointed truck.
